quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo provides update on the denecimig Biologics License (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: US review of denecimig extended: the FDA informed Novo that its BLA review of denecimig for haemophilia A (with or without inhibitors, adults and children) is still ongoing and has not communicated a new timeline for regulatory action; the BLA was submitted in September 2025 with a regulatory decision anticipated in the third quarter of 2026. The FDA said ongoing facility remediation activities, following its pre-license inspection of the manufacturing site, are the cause of the extension and has not identified deficiencies in the clinical efficacy or safety data from the FRONTIER programme. Novo says the manufacturing-site feedback does not impact other marketed Novo products and the extra review time has no impact on its 2026 financial outlook; pending the regulatory decision, Novo aims to launch denecimig in the US in the first half of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: US decision previously anticipated Q3 2026, no new FDA timeline; US launch aimed for first half of 2027; no impact on 2026 financial outlook
